questions.question: What did the centurion say that amazed Jesus?
options: That he himself had built them a synagogue to worship in
That he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof
That he firmly believed in only one true and living God
That he had carefully kept every one of the commandments
questions.answer: That he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof
